description: This file is a Swift extension for the `CronSettings` structure, providing helper methods for UI display, such as formatting statuses, schedule summaries, durations, and calculating labels for upcoming task runs.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: A data structure representing scheduling settings, extended here with utility functions.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Computes and returns the currently selected `CronJob` based on `selectedJobId`.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Returns a `Color` representing the status, e.g., 'ok', 'error', 'skipped'.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Provides a human-readable summary of different `CronSchedule` cases.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a concise string.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Generates a label indicating how soon the next scheduled run is.
